verdict.rationale: WezTerm documents in-process Lua event callbacks (`wezterm.on`), but that is an adjacent feature. The evidence shows no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that an external programmatic consumer could subscribe to, and API/OpenAPI probes returned 404. With the webhooks axis applicable but no evidence that WezTerm provides it, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
